card.name: Perinița
card.tagline: Romania — traditional Romanian wedding folk dance
card.profile: Perinița (or Pernița) is a traditional Romanian wedding folk dance. The dance is typical in the Muntenia region. The dance consists of participants forming a circle with one of the participants holding a handkerchief (or pillow) while dancing inside the circle. A circle of unmarried young people dance and accept him on the day before the marriage of one of the girls and it should be the last partner dance in which they will participate. One of the guys goes out in the dance inside the circle, holding a handkerchief.
card.insight: They kiss on the cheek, the first person goes into the circle, while the second person repeats the process.

observation.dancers: Group of 12 dancers, mixed men and women, in couples.
observation.formation_and_space: Circle formation, moving clockwise and counter-clockwise.

observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, including side-to-side steps, small hops, and stamps on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in a circle, sometimes raising them, sometimes lowering them.

observation.costume_and_props: Traditional Romanian folk costumes: women in white blouses, embroidered vests, and skirts; men in white shirts, vests, and trousers.
